title: Refund Limits by Length of Service — Utility Pass-Through Service Rate Sheet
content:
**Provision.** For a refund of a credit balance on a final-billed Utility Pass-Through Service account, no more than 1000.00 dollars is refunded at one time for an account whose service began 180 or more whole months before the handling date, and no more than 600.00 dollars for one whose service began 60 to 179 whole months before. For a newer account this provision sets no limit of its own.

Service began on the account's service start date; whole months are counted from that date to the handling date. Any credit above the limit stays on the account for a later refund.

## Limits

| Whole months from service start to the handling date | Most refunded at one time |
|---|---|
| 180 or more | 1000.00 dollars |
| 60 to 179 | 600.00 dollars |
| 59 or fewer | no limit under this provision |

## Boundaries and figures (hypothetical)

| Account in service | Whole months | Credit available to refund | Refunded at one time |
|---|---|---|---|
| exactly 15 years | 180 | 820.00 | 820.00 |
| 14 years 11 months | 179 | 820.00 | 600.00, with 220.00 staying on the account |
| exactly 5 years | 60 | 450.00 | 450.00 |
| 25 years | 300 | 1,240.00 | 1000.00, with 240.00 staying on the account |
